quote: Martin really understands how to transport a message in a way that everybody stays engaged and focused. I think that this is really important especially in an virtual environment. With respect to the topic of our training itself, I can only say that I thought that this course would likely be a refresher. In fact though I learned a lot. I am very inspired to put in action what we discussed with a particular view to how to better structure the day and week.
author: Sebastian Wülbeck
subject: Soft Skills Training
